$comment: Pinned environment snapshots. A published result cites this file; changing a snapshot id is a breaking change to the benchmark and requires a MINOR suite version bump plus a re-run of every reported number.

sim-erp5250.note: The simulator seeds deterministically from packages/solari/src/sim/data.ts, so no snapshot id is needed. Its determinism is asserted by packages/solari/test/sim.test.ts.

odoo-18-seeded.note: Populate with the id printed by `pnpm tsx scripts/seed-env.ts odoo`. Null means the environment has never been seeded, and every odoo-* task is skipped.
